title: Products
slug_description: Unique URL identifier for the product
categoryHelp: A category is a group that brings together similar products (e.g. Clothing, Electronics, Skincare) to make it easier for your customers to find your product. Click the + icon to create a new category if you don't find a suitable one.
slugHelp: Unique URL identifier for the product (Slug)

placeholders.descriptionPlaceholder: Write a detailed product description including features and benefits...
placeholders.tagsPlaceholder: Add a tag and press Enter...

pricing.endDateBeforeStart: ⚠️ End date must be after start date

inventory.trackInventoryHint: Enable this option if you want to track the quantity in stock for this product
inventory.lowStockThresholdHint: You will be alerted when inventory drops below this level
inventory.noTracking: Inventory will not be tracked for this product. It will always appear as available to customers.

attributes.title: 📋 Attributes
attributes.description: Add attributes like color and size to create product variations
attributes.customDesc: Create attributes specific to your product

variants.title: Variants
variants.noVariantsDesc: Add variants to your product such as different colors or sizes

display.title: Customize Variant Display
display.description: Choose how variants (colors, sizes) are displayed to customers on the product page. These settings are specific to this product only and override global settings.
display.noVariationAttributesDesc: Add attributes like "Color" or "Size" in the Attributes tab first.
display.customizeImageLabel: You can customize an image for each value (e.g., fabric photo for red color). These images will appear when selecting the "Thumbnails" style.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.featuredHint: Product will appear on homepage and featured sections
advanced.isHiddenHint: The product will only be visible to you in the dashboard and will not appear in the storefront.
advanced.shippingClassHint: Determines shipping cost based on product type
advanced.excludeFromFreeShippingHint: Will not be eligible for free shipping offers even if order reaches minimum amount
advanced.enableCheckoutForm: Enable checkout form for this product
advanced.enableCheckoutFormHint: Allows customers to complete purchase directly from product page
advanced.showAddToCart: Show Add to Cart button on product page
advanced.showAddToCartHint: When disabled, "Add to Cart" button will not appear
advanced.sizeGuideHint: You can add a size guide table for the product. It will be displayed to customers on the product page.
advanced.recommendedProductsDesc: Select specific products to display as recommendations. They will be merged with automatic system recommendations.
advanced.relatedProductsDesc: Products from the same category or similar to the current product
advanced.upsellProductsDesc: Better and more expensive products to encourage customer upgrade
advanced.crosssellProductsDesc: Products typically purchased with this product
advanced.enterProductId: Enter product ID and press Enter
advanced.recommendedProductsNote: ℹ️ Note: System automatically suggests products based on category and past purchases. Products selected here will be added to automatic recommendations.
advanced.addTag: Add new tag and press Enter
